# OpenAPI React Query Codegen

> `@7nohe/openapi-react-query-codegen` is a CLI (`openapi-rq`) that generates TanStack Query v5 (React Query) hooks from an OpenAPI 2.0/3.x specification. It builds a TypeScript HTTP client with @hey-api/openapi-ts in `<output>/requests/`, then generates typed `useQuery`, `useSuspenseQuery`, `useInfiniteQuery` and `useMutation` hooks, `queryOptions` factories, `prefetchQuery` / `ensureQueryData` helpers and query key functions in `<output>/queries/`.

Key facts for agents:

- Install: `npm install -D @7nohe/openapi-react-query-codegen` and `npm install @tanstack/react-query`. Only the scoped package belongs to this project.
- Run: `openapi-rq -i ./openapi.yaml -o ./src/openapi`. Keep the flags in a package.json script and always pass the same ones.
- Do not edit generated files. Change the spec or the flags and regenerate.
- `--check` writes nothing and exits 1 when the committed output is out of date, which makes it a CI drift check.
- `--json` prints failures as one line of JSON on stderr: `{"code","message","details"}`. Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 out of date, 2 error.
- The npm package ships an `AGENTS.md` with the full flag table, the generated layout, naming conventions and error codes.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://openapi-react-query-codegen.vercel.app/guides/introduction/): install, first run, generated layout, client setup
- [Usage](https://openapi-react-query-codegen.vercel.app/guides/usage/): using the generated query, suspense, mutation, infinite, prefetch and ensureQueryData exports
- [CLI Options](https://openapi-react-query-codegen.vercel.app/guides/cli-options/): every flag with defaults
- [CI and Coding Agents](https://openapi-react-query-codegen.vercel.app/guides/ci-and-agents/): `--check`, `--json`, exit codes, error codes, AGENTS.md
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/7nohe/openapi-react-query-codegen/blob/main/AGENTS.md): agent guide, also at `node_modules/@7nohe/openapi-react-query-codegen/AGENTS.md`
